title: Thomas Edison, the Inventor
text:
Thomas Edison was an American inventor. He was born in 1847 in Ohio. As a child, he did not go to school for very long, but he loved to read and make experiments at home. Edison is famous for the light bulb. He improved the light bulb so that it could work for many hours.

Edison had a large laboratory in New Jersey. He worked there with many other people. Edison received more than 1,000 patents for his inventions. A patent is a legal document that protects an invention, so other people cannot copy it easily.
